```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38)
library(EnsDb.Hsapiens.v86)
library(parallel)
library(TFBlearner)
library(data.table)
library(GenomicRanges)
library(BiocParallel)

setDTthreads(as.integer(params$threads))
```


# Compile object

```{r, determine training/testing combinations, error=TRUE}
combinations <- fread(file.path("../..", params$combinationsPath))
trainData <- subset(combinations, set=="trainData")
testData <- subset(combinations, set=="testData")

valContexts <- unique(testData$CellularContext)
valContexts
```

# Add additional data support

Add additional motif data and ChIP-seq data of non-benchmarked TFs.
```{r, add additional data, eval=TRUE, error=TRUE}
mae <- readRDS(file.path("../..", params$maePath))
dhsRanges <- rowRanges(mae[["ChIP"]])

# maeFull <- readRDS("../../data/TFBlearner/addSupport/maeAddSupport.rds")
# cols <- lapply(experiments(maeFull), function(n) {
#         colnames(n)[colnames(n) %in% unique(subset(sampleMap(maeFull), 
#              isTraining)$colname)]})
# maeFull <- subsetByColumn(maeFull, cols)

# add additional ChIP-data -----------------------------------------------------
addChIPPath <- file.path("../..", params$chipPath)
addChIPData <- HDF5Array(filepath=addChIPPath, name=TFBlearner:::PEAKASSAY)
chIPSeAdd <- SummarizedExperiment(assays=list(addChIPData),
                                  rowRanges=dhsRanges)

# remove tfs already in there before, subset to training


chIPSeAdd <- experiments(maeFull)$ChIP
chIPSeAdd <- IRanges::subsetByOverlaps(chIPSeAdd, dhsRanges, type = "equal")
chIPSe <- experiments(mae)$ChIP

# use only TFs which are not used already
chIPSeAdd <- chIPSeAdd[,!(chIPSeAdd$tfName %in% chIPSe$tfName)]
chIPSeComb <- cbind(chIPSe, chIPSeAdd)
chIPMap <- data.frame(primary=colData(chIPSeComb)[["context"]],
                      colname=colData(chIPSeComb)[["combination"]],
                      stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
allContexts <- unique(colData(chIPSeComb)$context)

# same ATAC-data as basic object -----------------------------------------------
atacSe <- experiments(mae)$ATAC
atacMap <- data.frame(primary=colData(atacSe)[["context"]],
                      colname=colData(atacSe)[["context"]],
                      stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
atacPromSe <- experiments(mae)$ATAC.Promoters
atacPromMap <- data.frame(primary=colData(atacPromSe)[["context"]],
                          colname=colData(atacPromSe)[["context"]],
                          stringsAsFactors=FALSE)

# add additional Motif-Data ----------------------------------------------------
motifsSeComb <- experiments(maeFull)$Motifs
motifsSeComb <- IRanges::subsetByOverlaps(motifsSeComb, dhsRanges, type = "equal")
metadata(colData(motifsSeComb))$baseDir <- "../../data/TFBlearner/addSupport/assays/motifs"

motifMap <- data.frame(primary=rep(allContexts, ncol(motifsSeComb)),
                       colname=rep(colnames(motifsSeComb),
                                   each=length(allContexts)),
                       stringsAsFactors=FALSE)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# annotate
objList <- list(atacSe, atacPromSe, chIPSeComb, motifsSeComb)
names(objList) <- c("ATAC", "ATAC.Promoters", "ChIP", "Motifs")

listMap <- list(atacMap, atacPromMap, chIPMap, motifMap)
names(listMap) <- c("ATAC", "ATAC.Promoters", "ChIP", "Motifs")
dfMap <- listToMap(listMap)

annoData <- data.frame(row.names=allContexts)
annoData[["context"]] <- unique(colData(chIPSeComb)$context)

# create mae with additional support
mae <- MultiAssayExperiment(experiments=objList, colData=annoData,
                            sampleMap=dfMap)
matchedContexts <- intersect(colnames(atacSe), colData(chIPSe)$context)

annoDt <- as.data.table(sampleMap(mae))
annoDt[,isTesting:=fifelse(primary %in% valContexts, TRUE, FALSE)]
annoDt[,isTraining:=fifelse(!(primary %in% valContexts) &
                              primary %in% matchedContexts, TRUE, FALSE)]

primary <- colData(mae)[["context"]]
colData(mae)$isTesting <- fifelse(primary %in% valContexts, TRUE, FALSE)
colData(mae)$isTraining <- fifelse(!(primary %in% valContexts) &
                                     primary %in% matchedContexts, TRUE, FALSE)
sampleMap(mae) <- annoDt
saveRDS(mae, file.path("../..", params$outDir, "01_maeAddSupport.rds"))
gc()
```
